title: EtaleResolutionSectionCanonicalData
statement: For every scheme $X$, abelian sheaf $G$ on its small etale site, and injective resolution $I$ of $G$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions], there is a normalized comparison for $I$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-canonical-comparison]. This assertion involves one resolution on one scheme and no morphism between schemes, no chain lift, and no naturality conclusion.

source.place: Tag 0A50, sections of an injective resolution; Tag 03F3 (2), localization; Read the corresponding Stacks tag pages; cocycle expansion of the parent proof, written by W3.

proof.text: Use the constant-sheaf/sections adjunction and evaluation at 1 in each resolution term. Its naturality identifies cocycles and boundaries, and the injective-resolution Ext equivalence sends the class represented by f to extMk f. This gives the normalized global comparison in every degree.

Apply the sheafification/free/Yoneda sections equivalence at every open W in each term; it commutes with differentials. The same Ext computation gives the section homology to free-representable Ext comparison. Compose with the independently constructed bijective open-object cohomology map; its values on cocycles are the required normalized values.
